We actually give away FREE COURSES when it comes to
cases.content:
Something interesting I noticed is that people don’t understand a lot of what I actually do, especially on the coaching, cohorts and courses side.

We actually give away FREE COURSES when it comes to “growing a YouTube Channel” and we don’t sell information to beginners.

I have the only 30 Hour Free YouTube Course training that existed and 12 handcrafted, not AI generated, PDFs to go with it 200 unique pages.

Coaching is DIRECT problem solving on an individual creators terms.

Helping with everything from hiring and firing, to logistics, to brand deal negotiation, to launching full physical products or digital products, and yes, more advanced channels strategy, not just for growth but sustainability and workflows.

For example, a creator I worked with was spending 8 hours on a process because they never had even basic instruction or formal training in their tools or never talked to anyone about their workflow.

We cut that down to 2 hours because they were making high quality but basic videos in the make inefficient way possible and didn’t know how to properly sync audio or realize that they could automate the removal of silences… and they had an inefficient process for their voice overs.

This creator was doing 2 videos per week… inefficiently at 16-25 hours of effort and we cut it down to less than 10 in a single call…. Giving them another 15 hours a week back with their kid… 

With no loss in quality and no loss in quantity.

Maybe they could have found that advice for free… but they didn’t for 2 years and lost HUNDREDS of hours because of it.

The things we will be launching courses around are SYSTEMS for the business side of Content Creation:

Brand Deals and Sponsorship 
UGC (User Generated Content)
Memberships & Subscription 
Paid Public Speaking & Appearances
Operations and Managing Teams

Most creators SUCK at business.
So these are the 5 paid courses we are launching.

Anyone who puts the systems not just the information, into practice should be able to increase their rates and their revenue for what they are charging and be able to negotiate better contracts.

If you’re serious you can’t lose money or be a worse position when you now have systems and SOPs you didn’t have in place and safe guards against bad deals and know how to properly manage partnerships and platforms.

One creator was going to undercharge and only ask for $500 per video, and I was able to explain to her why at a minimum she could charge $1500 per video (she can tell this story herself if she wants to and sees this) on a 6 video deal, and not to worry about her subscriber count… and worry more about how she aligns to the brand and their goals. 

The brand said yes with no haggling at all and she got $9000 instead of $3000.

Creators don’t value themselves enough because they think like artists and not like agencies.

I worked in traditional advertising… I understand the bridge to the commercial world and what is valued and how it’s priced.

Platforms have used the concept of CPM/RPM to convince creators that is what they are worth….

But you don’t realize that’s is a bulk blind buy…  and your value is diluted before the platform even takes its cut.

You’re worth more than your RPM says you are, but you don’t know how to validate that.

And sometimes it takes an outsider to show you what you’re capable of earning and asking for.

That’s the real problem I am aiming to solve.

Helping creators treat content like a business so they can stop undervaluing themselves. 

But it doesn’t work if I treat my own business like a charity.

Which is why I also primarily but not exclusively prefer to work with Creators in their 30s and 40s or older…

Because those creators are less resistant to the idea of prioritizing making money, and making content sustainable for their lifestyle…

That’s where I feel the value in Coaching lies, making this sustainable long term as a business and career

A lot of YouTube channels are currently blowing up especially channels creating cartoon animations, baby videos, kids’ educational content, short animated stories, and anime-style videos.

And guess w
cases.content:
A lot of YouTube channels are currently blowing up especially channels creating cartoon animations, baby videos, kids’ educational content, short animated stories, and anime-style videos.

And guess what?

Many of these creators are making serious money on YouTube. Why?

Because children love visual storytelling. Kids can watch animated content over and over again without getting tired of it. Parents also constantly look for entertaining and educational content for their children.

Now here’s the interesting part…

You no longer need a big animation studio to create these kinds of videos.

You don’t need to know complicated animation software.

You don’t need to be a professional cartoon artist.

With AI, you can now generate videos like these create characters, scenes, animations, voices, storytelling, and even full cartoon episodes.

And once you understand the process, you can start posting consistently on YouTube and build a channel that can eventually become monetized.

I personally have a monetized YouTube channel, so I’m not just saying this based on theory this is something I understand from experience.

Now…

The picture you’re currently seeing is called a Storyboard.

So what exactly does a storyboard do?

A storyboard is basically the visual blueprint of your video.

Before creating a cartoon, animation, movie, advert, or cinematic content, creators first plan out every scene visually.

A storyboard helps you:

✔ Plan scenes before creating the actual video
✔ Understand what each shot will look like
✔ Keep your storytelling organized
✔ Avoid confusion during production
✔ Make your animation smoother and more professional

Think of it like this:

Before building a house, you first need a building plan.

That’s exactly what a storyboard is for video creation.

It helps you map out your story before generating the final visuals.

Now let me quickly clear a very common misconception…

A lot of people believe:

“YouTube does not monetize AI-generated videos.”

That is not completely true.

YouTube does accept AI-generated content, but there’s a condition:

Your content must provide value, originality, storytelling, editing, creativity, or transformation.

YouTube mainly rejects content that is low-effort, repetitive, copied, spammy, or mass-produced without originality.

So if you’re creating original animations, storytelling videos, educational kids’ content, anime videos, cinematic stories, or unique AI-generated content with effort and creativity, there is absolutely opportunity there.

The truth is this AI is not replacing creators. AI is giving smart creators leverage.

If you learn how to use these tools properly, you can literally create content that would normally require an entire production team.

If you want to learn how to create:

✨ AI cartoon videos
✨ AI animated stories
✨ Anime videos
✨ AI baby/kids YouTube content
✨ Viral AI videos
✨ Storyboards like this
✨ Cinematic AI content
✨ And learn the exact tools and workflow

Then register for my AI Creator Class.

I’ll show you the process step-by-step even if you’re a beginner.

This is one skill that can open opportunities in content creation, freelancing, brand work, and even building your own monetized pages.

Click the link in my bio or comment if you’re interested 🔥

cases.content:
【MoneyPrinterTurbo 要約】
https://t.co/rAl4YFWXr0
完全無料・オープンソース（MITライセンス）のAI自動短動画生成ツール。
テーマ1つ入れるだけで、エンドツーエンドで動画が出来上がります。
■ 核心
「指示→完成」まで全部AIがやってくれる。
人間がやるのは「良い動画を選んで投稿するだけ」になりました。
■ 主な機能
・LLM（Claude/GPT/Gemini/DeepSeekなど）で台本自動生成
・著作権フリーの高画質映像を自動検索・取得
・Edge TTS or Azureで自然なナレーション合成
・字幕自動生成（フォント・色・アニメーションも調整可）
・BGM自動追加
・縦型（9:16）・横型（16:9）両対応で即書き出し
■ 初心者向け起動方法
1.  Windows版 → update.bat → start.bat（2クリック）
2.  Google Colab版 → ノートブック1つで即実行 （Docker版が一番安定）
■ マネタイズ案（これが一番大事）
1.  完全無顔チャンネル運用 → 「猫の豆知識」「お金持ちの習慣」「1分心理学」など定番ネタを毎日10本量産 → YouTube Shorts / TikTok / Instagram Reelsで広告収益＋アフィリエイト （海外事例では月$6,000〜$10,000達成者続出）
2.  クライアント向け代行 → 企業・個人事業主の商品紹介動画を「1本1,000〜3,000円」で受注 → 1日10本作れるので月収30〜50万円も現実的
3.  自分の商品作成 → ツールで作った動画をそのままオンライン講座やnoteの集客に活用 → 「AI動画量産講座」自体を商品化して売ることも可能
要するに**「作る手間がほぼゼロになった」**ことで、
これまでは時間的に無理だった「量×質」の両立が誰でも可能になりました。
今すぐ試したい人は
→ Windows一発版 or Colab版が一番簡単です！
